definitions.explanation: the central part of a flower, including the pistil and stamens

examples.japanese: {花芯|かしん}に{蜂|はち}が{止|と}まっている。
examples.english: A bee is resting on the center of the flower.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}の{花芯|かしん}が{赤|あか}く{色|いろ}づいてきた。
examples.english: The centers of the cherry blossoms have begun to turn red.

examples.japanese: マクロレンズで{撮影|さつえい}すると、{花芯|かしん}の{繊細|せんさい}な{構造|こうぞう}まではっきりと{見|み}ることができる。
examples.english: When photographing with a macro lens, you can clearly see the delicate structure of the flower's center.

notes:
Refers to the central reproductive part of a flower, encompassing the pistil ({雌|め}しべ) and stamens ({雄|お}しべ). Used in botany, gardening, flower arrangement ({華道|かどう}), and photography contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花芯|かしん}の{色|いろ}: color of the flower center
- {花芯|かしん}が{開|ひら}く: the flower center opens
- {花芯|かしん}に{触|ふ}れる: to touch the flower center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雌|め}しべ: pistil — the female reproductive part specifically
- {雄|お}しべ: stamen — the male reproductive part specifically
- {花弁|かべん}: petal — the outer colorful parts surrounding the center
- {花蕊|かずい}: flower stamen — a more technical botanical term
